title: La Kour — The Vigils of Brumecombe (English)
description:
Every autumn, the mist cuts Brumecombe off from the rest of the world. And every morning, someone is missing.

A pack hides among the villagers: unmask it before it devours you. An original social deduction game for 6 to 18 players, narrated by the AI GM.
